beginner.title: Get started with Lotsa Helping Hands
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Lotsa Helping Hands, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up with privacy in mind
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Lotsa Helping Hands and control your data

beginner.title: Daily habit
beginner.outcome: You can: use Lotsa Helping Hands daily without effort
beginner.practice: Use Lotsa Helping Hands daily for a week

intermediate.title: Read your trends
intermediate.outcome: You can: understand what the data says
intermediate.practice: Review a month of data and set one goal

intermediate.title: Share with a professional
intermediate.practice: Prepare a summary for a coach or clinician

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Lotsa Helping Hands
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Lotsa Helping Hands distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Lotsa Helping Hands
expert.outcome: You can: use Lotsa Helping Hands's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Coach others
expert.outcome: You can: use Lotsa Helping Hands to support clients or family
expert.practice: Set up Lotsa Helping Hands for a client or family member

expert.title: Integrate Lotsa Helping Hands into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Lotsa Helping Hands with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Lotsa Helping Hands to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Lotsa Helping Hands well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Lotsa Helping Hands" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
